content.json:
# Application Logs

Application Insights telemetry covering exceptions, request performance, dependency health, custom events, and trace log analysis.

content.title: Top Exceptions by Type & Frequency
Exception Trend Over Time

content.query:
// Request performance by operation – avg duration, failure rate, volume
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| summarize
    RequestCount  = count(),
    AvgDurationMs = round(avg(DurationMs), 1),
    P95DurationMs = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 1),
    FailureRate   = round(100.0 * countif(Success == false) / count(), 2)
    by OperationName
| top 25 by RequestCount desc
| project OperationName, RequestCount, AvgDurationMs, P95DurationMs, FailureRate
content.title: Request Performance by Operation

content.query:
// Dependency call failures and latency
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| summarize
    CallCount     = count(),
    FailureCount  = countif(Success == false),
    AvgDurationMs = round(avg(DurationMs), 1),
    P95DurationMs = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 1)
    by DependencyType, Target, OperationName
| extend FailureRate = round(100.0 * FailureCount / CallCount, 2)
| top 25 by FailureCount desc
| project DependencyType, Target, OperationName, CallCount, FailureCount, FailureRate, AvgDurationMs, P95DurationMs
content.title: Dependency Failures & Latency
Dependency Latency Trend by Type
Custom Events by Volume

content.query:
// Trace logs severity distribution
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| summarize TraceCount = count() by SeverityLevel
| extend Severity = case(
    SeverityLevel == 0, 'Verbose',
    SeverityLevel == 1, 'Information',
    SeverityLevel == 2, 'Warning',
    SeverityLevel == 3, 'Error',
    SeverityLevel == 4, 'Critical',
    strcat('Level ', tostring(SeverityLevel))
  )
| project Severity, SeverityLevel, TraceCount
| order by SeverityLevel asc
content.title: Trace Severity Distribution
